title: Travel & Lodging
text:
The Legacy Lodge is a 2 1/2 hour drive from both Phoenix Sky Harbor and Flagstaff Pulliam Airport.
The last stretch is a dirt access road. Take it slow and enjoy the scenery. Cell service can be spotty in the mountains. Before you leave Phoenix, please download your directions as you may lose service on your way in.

title: Travel & Lodging
section: Looking for things to do while you’re here?
text:
Looking for things to do while you’re here?

Black Canyon Lake. A quiet trout lake in the national forest, about 15 miles southwest of Heber. Fish for rainbow trout and keep an eye out for wild horses that come to the lake to drink. Anglers need an Arizona fishing license.
The Rim Lakes and Rim Road. About 25 miles west on Highway 260 along the Mogollon Rim. Willow Springs Lake and Woods Canyon Lake are the most popular for trout fishing and kayaking, and Woods Canyon rents boats on site. The Rim Lakes Vista Trail is a short hike with wide views, and Forest Road 300 is a 45-mile scenic drive along the top of the Rim.
Petrified Forest National Park. Roughly 65 miles northeast, you’ll find petrified wood and Painted Desert views.
Payson and Tonto Natural Bridge State Park. Payson is about 55 miles southwest. The bridge is believed to be the largest natural travertine bridge in the world, rising 183 feet over a 400-foot tunnel.

title: FAQ
text:
Is there a ceremony?
No, we were married in a private ceremony on 07.10.26. We can't wait to celebrate our union with everyone!



What should I wear and pack?
 Friday's dresscode is dressy casual. Think sundresses, khakis or jeans, and summery polos. Saturday is a laid-back field day, so wear whatever's comfortable and easy to move in.We'll be on the grass both days, so wear shoes that won't sink into the ground. Northern Arizona evenings get chilly even when the day is warm, bring layers or a warm jacket.



Can we swim in the pond?
Yes! Towels, pool noodles and water guns are provided, just pack a swimsuit. The pond is gated and fenced, and we ask that any kiddos in the water have a grown-up keeping watch.



Where should I stay?
Our Travel & Lodging page has hotel and cabin rental recommendations. Heber is a small town so if you know you're coming, we suggest booking your lodging soon.



Is there a shuttle or a ride plan?
There's no shuttle, we recommend renting a car. Rideshare from the venue to nearby hotels and cabins is largely unavailable, so please don't count on it. Rideshare is not available from either airport.If you'd like to coordinate with other guests arriving or departing around the same time, send us a note at therobeywatsons@gmail.com and we'll do our best to connect folks.



Is this a family-friendly weekend?
Yes! We know it's Mother's Day weekend and you may want to celebrate with your family. Your RSVP will list everyone in your party. Saturday is a laid-back day of games, movies, and good company for families and friends to come together. If you have any questions about your party, please reach out.



When is the RSVP deadline?
Please reply by February 14, 2027 on the RSVP page.



Should I worry about UFOs or Bigfoot?
Maybe, if you believe local legends. In 1975, a logger working in the nearby forest vanished for five days and resurfaced in Heber claiming a UFO abduction, a story that inspired the 1993 film Fire in the Sky. The Mogollon Rim is also said to be home to the Mogollon Monster, Arizona's answer to Bigfoot.



Who do I ask if I have another question?
Email us at therobeywatsons@gmail.com or send a text to either of us.
